name: use-supported
title: useSupported
description: Custom hook that safely checks if a specific feature or browser API is supported.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: - A function that attempts to access or use the feature/API.

parameters.name: sync
parameters.description: - If true, evaluates the support synchronously using `useIsomorphicLayoutEffect` instead of `useEffect`.

returnType.name: boolean
returnType.description: True if the callback executes successfully and returns a truthy value, false otherwise.
